summary: Iter 260 frontend-only validation for KOLOR Studio: SettingsContext migration, AccountDangerZone rename, and Recharts ResponsiveContainer fix. Login + Dashboard + Settings modal end-to-end tested via Playwright. All 3 iteration goals verified as working.
action_items: None blocking. Iter 260 changes verified working. Note: modal-open fires 2 GET /api/settings in dev (down from 3) instead of 1 due to React.StrictMode double-invocation of useEffect in main.tsx; production builds will fire 1. This is expected framework behavior, not a code defect.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsContext.tsx (l52-63): uses `any` cast for settingsApi.get() response — consider proper typing later for maintainability.
SettingsModal.tsx (l34-95): SettingsProvider JSX indentation is inconsistent (parent has no indent while child divs are indented) — cosmetic only.

MoneyTab.tsx onChange handlers call save() on every change (immediate PATCH on each keystroke for defaultTaxRate number input). Could hammer the backend if user types quickly. Consider debouncing PATCH for numeric inputs. Not a regression from iter 260 — pre-existing pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Dashboard shows a Welcome tutorial modal + Quotes Accepted celebration modal + cookie banner on first login for the test user. Use dismiss loop clicking 'Accept All', 'Awesome!', 'Skip'/'Skip tour' buttons. The sidebar-settings testid button opens the modal — clicking via page.click(force=True) can be intercepted by these overlays; using page.evaluate to call el.click() directly on the DOM element bypasses the interception reliably.

1_settings_context_single_fetch.verdict: PASS — context migration works; the doubling is dev-only StrictMode artefact. Was 3 (one per useUserSettings consumer) pre-migration; now single provider effect fires (2× in dev, 1× in prod). Tab-switch 0 GETs confirms consumers no longer trigger fetches.
